Question 3
?

Consider the arc of the curve y=−x3+4x2−4x that lies in the fourth quadrant between its x-intercepts. What integral gives the area of the surface generated when this arc is rotated 2π radians about the y-axis?

a
2π∫02x1+(−3x2+8x−4)2dx
b
2π∫02x(−3x2+8x−4)dx
c
2π∫01(−x3+4x2−4x)2dx
d
2π∫021+(−3x2+8x−4)2dx
e
2π∫01x1+(−x3+4x2−4x)2dx
